_comment: Lenny's one-off messages at a set time, Bradenton time. Posted by build/post_scheduled.py; it fills in "posted" and "message" once sent.

posts.text:
@everyone

🦃 **Happy Thanksgiving, Kava!** 🦃

Lenny here, stuffed with gratitude (and maybe a little pie 🥧). Today's all about saying thank you, so here goes!

🚫 **No club tonight**
Adobe Kava night is off for Thanksgiving, **Thursday, Nov 26**. Enjoy your family and friends! We're back **Sunday, Nov 29 at 8:00 PM** ♟️

🙏 **Thank you for an amazing year of chess**
Every Sunday bracket, every Tuesday study night, every game that came down to the last second ⏱️. You made all of it happen. What a year! 🔥

👋 **To all our new members**
Welcome to the family! You sat down at a board and made Kava better. We're so glad you're here 💛

🏛️ **To our OG players**
You built this. You keep showing up, keep teaching and keep pushing everyone to play better. Keep that fire going, because the new crew is learning from you 💪

🚀 **Jump in for the new year**
Never played a bracket? Next year is your year. Grab a seat, play a game, ask a question. Everybody starts somewhere! 🎉

✨ **What makes Kava special**
It's not the boards or the clocks. It's YOU: the players, the community, and the vibes you bring to the board all year long. Let's keep it going and keep those vibes strong! 🌴♟️

💌 **A special message from the director**
> This Thanksgiving I'm grateful for every one of you. Directing this club is an honor I never take lightly. You show up hungry to learn and grow, and you inspire me every day to keep improving as a player, as a leader and as a person.
> 
> Kava has always been about more than chess. It's friendship, respect and community, and I want to keep those vibes strong at the board and away from it. My promise is to keep giving you things that are full of value: lessons, events and moments that help you grow in chess, in life and in yourself.
> 
> Stay strong, stay kind, and keep growing. Happy Thanksgiving, family. 🧡
> — Harold

🍗 Eat well, rest up, and we'll see you Sunday! ♟️
— Lenny 🤖
